title: Sort
description: A Beatles cover you can pixel sort with your hand. Drag down and the columns under your pointer pull into long vertical streaks, every bright span sorted by brightness; drag back up and the pixels go home.
intent: The pixel-sorted smear behind the blob-tracking edit, made touchable: a real per-column sort within threshold spans, recomputed only for the columns your drag touches so it keeps up with the pointer.
sources: herb reference board: Pinterest video #896638607050931780 (pixel-sorted background)
